Job Title: Back End Engineer Location: Bangalore, India (Work from Office) Industry/Field: Retail Experience: 2-5 years Company: Tredence About Us: Tredence differentiates itself from other analytics services firms by enabling last mile adoption of insights. We drive true business impact by uniting our strengths in business analytics, data science, and software engineering. We help our clients deliver on the artificial intelligence imperative in a practical and demystified way. To know more about us, visit: www.tredence.com Job Overview: As a Back End Engineer at Tredence, you will design, develop, and maintain scalable backend systems focused on the retail industry using Python technologies. Success in this role means delivering robust, efficient, and maintainable code that powers intelligent applications impacting business decisions. You will collaborate closely with cross-functional teams, including data scientists and front-end engineers, to translate complex data insights into actionable software solutions. This position plays a critical role in driving advanced analytics capabilities that enable our clients' AI initiatives end-to-end. What will your role look like? - Develop and maintain backend services and APIs using Python frameworks such as Django and Flask. - Implement efficient data processing workflows leveraging data structures and libraries like NumPy and Pandas. - Collaborate with DevOps teams to deploy and manage applications on Kubernetes clusters. - Write clean, reusable, and well-documented code following object-oriented programming principles. - Optimize backend performance and scalability to handle large datasets typical of retail analytics. - Participate in code reviews, testing, and continuous integration to ensure high-quality software delivery. - Work closely with data science teams to integrate machine learning models and analytics pipelines. You will need: - Demonstrate 2-5 years of professional experience in backend development primarily using Python. - Possess a BE/B.Tech degree from a recognized institution. - Exhibit strong knowledge of data structures, algorithms, and object-oriented programming (OOPS) concepts. - Proficiently use Python frameworks such as Django and Flask to build web services. - Experience with data manipulation and analysis using libraries like NumPy and Pandas. - Understand container orchestration and deployment using Kubernetes. - Communicate effectively within cross-functional teams and contribute to collaborative development. Good to Have Skills: - Familiarity with retail domain analytics and related business processes. - Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP. - Knowledge of RESTful API design and security best practices. - Exposure to continuous integration/continuous deployment (CI/CD) pipelines and tools. - Working knowledge of frontend technologies to facilitate seamless integration. Why you will love this job: At Tredence, you will be part of a forward-thinking, dynamic team driving impactful AI and analytics solutions in the retail space. We offer ample opportunities for professional growth and continuous skill enhancement through challenging projects and mentorship. You will enjoy a collaborative work environment fostering innovation, work-life balance, and diversity. Joining us means contributing to meaningful business outcomes while advancing your expertise in data-driven backend engineering.
